subject: Tariff Update Notice: HS 8501.10 – Import Duty Change (effective 2026-09-15)
body: Effective 2026-09-15, the import duty rate for HS code 8501.10 (Electric motors, <37.5W) on shipments from COUNTRY_X into the EU increases from 4.5% to 7.8%, following updated trade agreement terms. Please ensure customs declarations and invoices reflect the new rate for all shipments departing on or after the effective date.
